text:
Nina Tran: quick sync — planning pilot rollout for marketplace listings. Key decisions: public vs private offers per cloud, telemetry disclosure, and price bundling for trial. Need to lock before we hand to cloud ops.

Omar Ali: I can drive the pricing matrix. Question: do we want a unified SKU across clouds or cloud-specific SKUs?

Becca Stone: cloud-specific SKUs please. Easier for reporting and partner reconciliation. Also makes promo/coupon mapping simpler per marketplace.

Rajiv Menon: agree with Becca. Also, for pilots we should set an explicit concurrency cap and seat limit in the trial SKU. Prevents accidental overuse.

Nina Tran: ok cloud-specific. Omar — add columns: `cloud`, `sku`, `trial_days`, `concurrency_limit`, `seat_limit`, `metering_unit`.

Omar Ali: will do. rough example: `aws,rwd-pilot-aws-14d,14,10,5,instance-hour`

LegalBot: Reminder: telemetry must be opt-out-able and disclosed on the listing page. Provide a short blurb <= 250 chars and link to privacy page. Also include data residency statements for EU/UK.

Becca Stone: drafting telemetry blurb: "Anonymous usage metrics collected to improve product; no customer content is stored. Opt-out available via support." Thoughts?

Rajiv Menon: clarify what we mean by "customer content" — better: "no request payloads are retained beyond transaction logs". Legal to sign off.

LegalBot: preferred wording: "We collect anonymized usage metrics and transient transaction logs for operational purposes; we do not retain prompt or response content beyond operational windows. See privacy link." Approve?

Becca Stone: works for me — I'll slot that into the listing copy.

marketplace-bot: Asset check: missing `support_url` and `privacy_url` in manifest. Also flag: Azure requires explicit `publisher_id`. See https://confluence.redwood/marketplace-manifests

Nina Tran: Omar — include support_url & privacy_url in the SKU manifest. Rajiv — can infra provide temp publisher slot for Azure test?

Rajiv Menon: I'll request a test publisher slot and ping Azure ops. If they approve, we get a publisher_id within 48h.

Omar Ali: uploading sample CSV to staging: gs://marketplace-staging/3023456789/prices.csv — includes per-cloud SKUs and limits.

Becca Stone: for listing copy char limits: AWS title 256, description 2000, GCP short desc 300. I'll trim translations to fit.

Nina Tran: good catch. Also include EU support hours and local support email if we list eu-west regions.

Rajiv Menon: FYI — pilot will be Private on AWS (partner offer) and Public on GCP/Azure. We'll mark `offer_visibility` accordingly in manifest.

marketplace-bot: Lint results: manifest has `offer_visibility` but `publisher_id` missing for Azure. Staging bucket created: s3://marketplace-ingest-stage-3023456789 .

Omar Ali: added `publisher_id` placeholder `redwood-test-pub` and will replace after Azure confirms.

LegalBot: add a short clause about non-renewing trial and billing initiation on first paid hour. Also ensure cancellation FAQ is linked.

Becca Stone: adding cancellation FAQ link and brief refund policy. Will add to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/pilot-marketplace-3023456789 (draft).

Nina Tran: actionable items:
- Omar: finalize CSV + manifest with support_url/privacy_url and post link (tomorrow).
- Rajiv: secure Azure test publisher id & update manifest (48h).
- Becca: finalize listing copy + translations + FAQ links (48h).
- LegalBot: final sign-off on telemetry & trial language (48h).

Rajiv Menon: scheduling 15-min sync with Azure ops and AWS listing rep for tomorrow; invite sent.

Omar Ali: will update the staging bucket and post final manifest when ready.

Becca Stone: once legal signs off I'll localize strings and push to Crowdin.

Nina Tran: thanks team — we'll reconvene here once artifacts are in staging. :rocket:
